CausalEvent.description: A narrative event node in the causal graph.

Counterfactual.description: A counterfactual: "What if event X hadn't happened?"

PlotHole.description: A plot hole: weak or broken causal chain.

turnCount.description: Turns containing at least one token; denominators exclude empty turns.

ConversationEdge.description: Directed edge in the conversation flow graph.

Monologue.description: A detected monologue (5+ consecutive lines from one speaker).

SameSoundingPair.description: A pair of characters whose voice profiles are too similar.

VoiceProfile.description: Voice profile for measuring how distinctive a character's speech patterns are.

frequentWords.description:
Top words by normalized frequency (freq > 0.02) within this character's
dialogue. These are the character's own most-used words; no
cross-character distinctiveness filter is applied.

range.description: Offsets within the exact original supplied turn, not within a scene.

eligibleTurnCount.description: Configured-speaker turns with at least one word.

emptyTurnCount.description: Zero-word turns, across both configured and unconfigured speakers.

wordCount.description: Words in eligible configured-speaker turns only.

turnCount.description: Turns containing at least one token; denominators exclude empty turns.

infoDumpCount.description: Compatibility placeholder 0; cues do not prove information dumping.

overallRealism.description: Compatibility placeholder 0.5; automatic editorial realism is unassessed.

dateConflict.description:
Integer-date comparison only, never proof of impossibility. Unassessed
when the catalogue requires sense confirmation and none was supplied.

FeatureDrift.description:
How a feature moved from baseline to current. `delta` is signed in
normalized [-1,1] space (current minus baseline); `baseline`/`current` are
the raw feature values for human-readable reporting.

quotationCandidateCount.description: Paired quotation candidates whose opening delimiter is in this paragraph.

VoiceDrift.description:
Result of measuring how far a revised voice has diverged from a baseline.

`overall` is the mean absolute normalized per-feature delta in [0,1]:
0.0 = no drift (identical profiles), 1.0 = maximal movement on every
feature. `per_feature` lists every dimension's signed normalized delta,
sorted by magnitude descending (ties broken by the fixed dimension order)
so the largest contributors lead. `notes` summarizes the dominant shifts in
plain language. `drifted` is a convenience flag: overall exceeds the
notable-drift threshold.

turnCount.description: Turns containing at least one token; denominators exclude empty turns.

charactersIntroduced.description: Legacy alias: capped capitalized-token candidates, not verified introductions.

dialogueOnsetParagraph.description: Index of the first paragraph that contains dialogue (0-based), or None.

firstLineWordCount.description: Word count of the first line (structural signal).

paragraphWordCounts.description: Word counts per paragraph (structural signal: paragraph-length trajectory).

worldEstablished.description: Legacy alias: setting/sensory wordlist threshold, not verified world clarity.

resolution.description: None means resolution is unknown, including when later prose appears to answer a question.

ThematicResolution.description: Resolution status for a single theme across the manuscript.

momentum.description:
Theme momentum: positive means increasing presence, negative means decreasing.
Computed from consecutive quartile average differences.

A legacy lexicon date-review candidate; historical dates/senses are unverified.

sceneCoverage.description: Union of surface anchors only; resolution evidence is excluded.

AnalyzeSyntaxTensionResult.description: Result of analyzing syntax tension in a single scene.
AnalyzeSyntaxTensionResult.title: SceneTensionResult

TimelineEntry.description:
One manuscript document's place in the timeline view: its id, its zero-based
position in manuscript order, and the first explicit time expression found in
its text (if any).

`time_hint` is the *matched substring* (whitespace-normalized), e.g.
`"March 1847"` or `"9:30"`, and is `None` when the document names no
recognized time. It carries no parsed/normalized calendar value on purpose —
the core does no date math at this layer, so the host owns any
interpretation.

documentId.description: The document's stable id (as supplied by the caller).

order.description:
Zero-based position in manuscript order. This is the *only* ordering v1
asserts; it is the input index, not a chronology inferred from hints.

timeHint.description:
The first detected explicit temporal expression in the document's text,
whitespace-normalized and trimmed; `None` when no time is named.

turnCount.description: Turns containing at least one token; denominators exclude empty turns.

absentCount.description: Number of conventions observed as absent (NotMet).

evidenceCoverage.description: Fraction of checklist entries with supplied judgments, not a quality score.

presentCount.description: Number of conventions observed as present (Met or Subverted).

ProseExample.description: A prose quality issue found in a scene.

contextCount.description: Nonzero prior vectors in the requested preceding scene window.

entropyCurve.description:
Neutral placeholders retained per scene for legacy shape compatibility.
No Shannon uncertainty is inferred from prose.

oneOf.description:
Explicit speech tags only, plus the narrative model's speaker when a
verified model is configured.

Also proximity and alternation guesses for quotes neither a tag nor the
model attributes.

tagVerb.description:
The speech verb used in the attribution tag (e.g. "whispered"), if
the line was attributed via an explicit speech tag.

range.description: Selects the exact original line.quote; delimiters and outside whitespace are excluded.

ModelManifest.description:
V1 profiles encode with tokenizer special tokens, reject tokenizer-side
truncation/padding, and right-pad IDs with `padding_token_id` and masks/types
with zero. Embeddings use masked mean pooling without normalization; class
logits are softmaxed and remapped to the crate's canonical label order.

The narrative model lists its entity head here.

nominalLabels.description:
The narrative model's nominal-mention labels in source-logit order
(`O`, `B-NOM`, `I-NOM`); empty for every other kind.

over one 400-token window wrapped in `[CLS]`/`[SEP]`.

TimelineOverride.description:
Writer-authored chronology metadata. It overlays conservative detection and
remains separate from prose, so changing a date or lane never rewrites text.

StoryFact.description:
A legacy lexical sentence candidate, not a verified story-world fact.
Importance is an uncalibrated marker tier, not probability or information bits.

CharacterKnowledgeState.description: Knowledge state for a single character.

ContinuityViolation.description: A potential conflict between observed physical-state assertions.

proof.description: The logical chain proving the violation.

severity.description: 0.0 = minor (object in wrong place), 1.0 = major (impossible knowledge).

oneOf.description: Character knows something they couldn't have learned.
Character is in a location they couldn't have reached.
Object appears where it shouldn't be.
Events reference something that hasn't happened yet (non-flashback).
Character references another character they haven't met.
Physical impossibility (locked room, distance).

WorldFact.description: A fact about the story world at a specific point in narrative time.

oneOf.description: Character is at a location.
Character possesses an object.
Character knows a piece of information.
Character has witnessed an event.
Two characters are in the same location (derived).
Communication occurred between characters.
Object is at a location.
A constraint: character CANNOT leave / is restricted.
Temporal fact: event X happened before event Y.

WorldStateDelta.description:
Net changes from the previous scene boundary (the initial state is empty).
Replay by removing invalidated_facts, then inserting new_facts. Facts created
and removed within one scene cancel; legacy snapshot event lists are unchanged.

WorldStateOptions.description:
Retention for the additive current-state API. Current facts, knowledge,
locations, violations and scores are always computed by the full reducer.

includeDeltas.description: Retain net changes at every reduced scene boundary, including empty ones.

includeEventHistory.description:
Retain told_by, locations_visited, location_timeline and information_flow.
False leaves those optional histories empty without suppressing learning.

TrackWorldStateCurrentResult.description: Final state without a cumulative fact-set copy for every scene.

afterScene.description: Zero-based last reduced scene; None for empty scenes or an empty cast.
